allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Dollex Agrotech Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates regarding the  Letter of Offer dated May 13, 2025, for the Rights Issue of Dollex Agrotech Limited.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Dollex Agrotech Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 08, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 14980800 : 24968000, i.e 14980800 Equity Shares for every 24968000 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 33 per share.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Dollex Agrotech Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on April 25, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 14980800 : 24968000, i.e 14980800 Equity Shares for every 24968000 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 33 per share.
